source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Draw color-3 horizontal and vertical segments between matching markers."""
    if not grid or not grid[0]:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != background}
    for marker in markers:
        for r in range(height):
            positions = [c for c in range(width) if grid[r][c] == marker]
            for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
                for c in range(left + 1, right):
                    if grid[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = 3
        for c in range(width):
            positions = [r for r in range(height) if grid[r][c] == marker]
            for top, bottom in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
                for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                    if grid[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
